time = #{time},
notify_group = #{notifyGroup},
publisher = #{publisher},
update_time = now()
where notify_id = #{notifyId}
mapper.select: select notify_id as notifyId,publisher,title,content,time,notify_group as notifyGroup from notifications where title like concat('%',#{value},'%') order by time desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
